def transform(grid):
    # Reflect isolated colored patterns across vertical panel dividers to the right.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # separators are full rows/columns in a framing color; identify columns and rows
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(h))]
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(x != 0 for x in grid[r])]
    # identify panel boundaries from separator locations
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        r0, r1 = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-2):
            c0, c1 = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            # object shape in panel; reflect into immediately following panel only when panel is empty,
            # and source is not a separator/background color.
            cells = [(r-r0,c-c0,grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] not in (0, grid[sep_rows[0]][sep_cols[0]] if sep_rows and sep_cols else -1)]
            if not cells:
                continue
            nc0, nc1 = cb[ci+1]+1, cb[ci+2]
            if nc1-nc0 != c1-c0 or any(out[r][c] != 0 for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(nc0,nc1)):
                continue
            for y,x,v in cells:
                out[r0+y][nc0+(c1-c0-1-x)] = v
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((v for v in range(1,10) if sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) > 0 and any(all(row[c] == v for c in range(w)) for row in grid)), None)
    if sep is None:
        # separator color by full horizontal/vertical lines
        sep = next(v for v in range(1,10) if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid))
    rs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == sep for x in row)]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb=[-1]+rs+[h]; cb=[-1]+cs+[w]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        r0,r1=rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(0,len(cb)-2,2):
            c0,c1=cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1]
            d0,d1=cb[ci+1]+1,cb[ci+2]
            # complete horizontal mirror pairs for equal-size neighboring cells
            if r1-r0 != r1-r0 or c1-c0 != d1-d0: continue
            a=[grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
            b=[grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(d0,d1)]
            if any(x != 0 for x in a) and not any(x != 0 for x in b):
                for y in range(r1-r0):
                    for x in range(c1-c0): out[r0+y][d0+x]=grid[r0+y][c1-1-x]
            elif any(x != 0 for x in b) and not any(x != 0 for x in a):
                for y in range(r1-r0):
                    for x in range(c1-c0): out[r0+y][c0+x]=grid[r0+y][d1-1-x]
    return out

 "path": "programs/task-b19440ce.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separating color is the color forming complete horizontal/vertical lines.
    sep = next(v for v in range(1, 10)
               if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid)
               and any(all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)))
    sr = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == sep for x in row)]
    sc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + sr + [h], [-1] + sc + [w]
    bands = [(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rb) - 1)]
    panels = [(cb[i] + 1, cb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cb) - 1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, sep))

    # A neighboring panel pair that contains one horizontally reflected pair
    # establishes a color-specific mirror rule for the other bands as well.
    for pi in range(len(panels) - 1):
        a0, a1 = panels[pi]
        b0, b1 = panels[pi + 1]
        if a1 - a0 != b1 - b0:
            continue
        pw = a1 - a0
        for color in colors:
            established = False
            for r0, r1 in bands:
                left = [[grid[r][a0 + x] == color for x in range(pw)] for r in range(r0, r1)]
                right = [[grid[r][b0 + x] == color for x in range(pw)] for r in range(r0, r1)]
                has_l = any(any(row) for row in left)
                has_r = any(any(row) for row in right)
                if has_l and has_r and all(left[y][x] == right[y][pw - 1 - x]
                                           for y in range(r1 - r0) for x in range(pw)):
                    established = True
                    break
            if not established:
                continue
            for r0, r1 in bands:
                has_l = any(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(a0, a1))
                has_r = any(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(b0, b1))
                if has_l == has_r:
                    continue
                src0, dst0 = (a0, b0) if has_l else (b0, a0)
                for r in range(r0, r1):
                    for x in range(pw):
                        if grid[r][src0 + x] == color:
                            out[r][dst0 + pw - 1 - x] = color
    return out
"
